**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

M&I's § 16.1 express warranties (system capability, substantial conformity of reports to the User Manuals/bulletins, rights to provide the Services, Millennium compliance) are open-ended for the term rather than limited to 12 months/90 days, so the duration element exceeds both the preferred and fallback positions. Compliance with law is covered by § 19.A. Remedies are real: service level credits (§ 9.2.D), cure/termination plus damages (§§ 12.1, 12.3), and direct damages that expressly include the cost of correcting errors, work-arounds and alternate-source procurement (§ 13.1). The all-caps disclaimer is expressly subject to "EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION 16.1", so it does not swallow the express warranties.

Noted but not flagged: no explicit "professional and workmanlike" standard (§ 9.1 uses commercially reasonable care), no malicious-code warranty, no dedicated repair/replace/refund sentence, and documentation amendable "from time to time".
